glaubenberg-pilatus-backroads.title: Glaubenberg · Pilatus Backroads
glaubenberg-pilatus-backroads.slogan: Forest, ridge air and less obvious central Switzerland.
glaubenberg-pilatus-backroads.story: Forest, ridge air and less obvious central Switzerland. 172 km round from Luzern - plan on about 3 h 18 of riding. On the way it passes Sarnen and Pilatus view road. The climb of the day is Glaubenberg pass road. It tops out at 1,543 m. It is a high-mountain day.

waypoints.name: Lucerne exit gate

waypoints.name: Glaubenberg pass road
waypoints.advice: You top out at 1543 m here. The road climbs 1107 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 7 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Sarnen food stop, mostly downhill.

waypoints.advice: Pilatus view road, about halfway at 1000 m. The road climbs 527 m on the way up to it, hard. Reckon on about 4 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is back to Lucerne, mostly downhill.

scenicChapters.title: Emmental Panorama Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1543 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 32 km. 527 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Lucerne Axenstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: 564 m come off over 31 km at around 5.0%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

glaubenberg-pilatus-backroads.storyWas: Forest, ridge air and less obvious central Switzerland.
